name: Natsuiro no Koware Mono After
original_name: 夏色のコワレモノ After
source:
Meet Enomoto Ryouka, the ace of the girls’ basketball team and your childhood friend.
Growing up together in a rural village, you’ve secretly harbored feelings for her—

But what kind of acts has she been forced to accept?
How have those filthy men exploited her body?

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01041151.html/]dlsite[/url]]
